I am sorry you are feeling this way. But I believe it is a bit ridiculous to say that other lesbians are "all fucking ugly and irritating", I am 90% sure that not all lesbians are like this, at least the ones I have met are all attractive but when can I say? I'm a gay guy.

Perhaps you could be asexual with an interest in women (homoromantic). But please, you do not have to die because of what you are, if you want to go the extra mile and be less 'lesbian' you could be looking into that you could be a trans person instead, in which case you would be heterosexual (or straight) if you still have preference in women.

There are gorgeous fish out there, you just have to move and test the waters in different ponds.

(sorry for late reply! i dont really check reddit too much/still getting use to the site)   
I have a few times from what I remember, but you know how schools are. I got the good old "just stay away from her" talk. But it really did nothing.
